mainEntity.name: Is ChatGPT Code Interpreter a Code Agent or a Data Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: It behaves as a **Code Agent** for **code interpreter data analysis**: it runs Python in a sandbox on uploaded files and returns artifacts. It is not a Data Agent — it lacks governed multi-source discovery, enterprise memory distillation, and inspectable multi-phase audit trails by default. Use it for exploration; do not confuse session speed with production readiness.

mainEntity.name: Can a Code Agent become a Data Agent with more connectors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connectors are necessary but not sufficient. A Data Agent also needs goal-driven orchestration, metric-definition negotiation, phase-level audit, and approved memory — not just database credentials pasted into a coding loop. Teams that bolt connectors onto interpreter patterns without those layers still score below **60%** on our enterprise card.

mainEntity.name: Which agent type is better for regulated industries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regulated industries should default to Data Agents for recurring **code interpreter data analysis** workloads that touch production schemas. Code Agents remain appropriate for isolated engineering sandboxes without regulated data. Align controls with [Google SRE book](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) and document which pattern owns which data class.
